gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-palanquin: One thick thread traced through every letter defines Pixelify Sans, a bold display voice. And Palanquin, a plain sans with wide, unclosed curves, gives that heading a contemporary, professional partner that stays out of its way.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-philosopher: Pixelify Sans moves its stems and arcs in lockstep. Philosopher, a plain sans, brings smooth, modest shifts in thickness and curves with plenty of daylight inside, so the page gains softness beneath the bold heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-pontano-sans: Strokes like fine rope laid into letter shapes make Pixelify Sans unmistakable. Pontano Sans has wide open terminals and low contrast, so a longer passage would read smoothly and contemporary beneath that heading.
